notes: Element X is the Matrix messenger on Google Play (io.element.android.x, 500k+ installs), designed against Element's Compound design system by an in-house design team. It has the largest preview corpus of anything surveyed: 494 preview-bearing files, of which 116 are in :libraries:designsystem alone — the buttons, dialogs, list items and avatars, each one screenshot-tested, which is what makes them self-contained enough to render outside the app. Ordinary Android Compose in src/main/kotlin, so the Robolectric lane. ref is develop, which is this project's default branch. previewAnnotations names PreviewsDayNight, the day/night multipreview the module's own previews carry: it is declared in this same module so the source pre-flight would probably see it, but naming it costs nothing and the failure it prevents ('matches no @Preview function in the scanned module') is opaque. Licence: AGPL-3.0 — see the note on the pull request. The render currently fails: all 321 previews die at class-init with ClassNotFoundException on androidx.customview.poolingcontainer.R$id — the ARTIFACT is on the classpath (PoolingContainer.kt:121 executes) and only its AGP-generated R class is missing. The plugin already pins that artifact onto the main variant for exactly this reason, and manageDependencies is on, so the pin applies and is not enough here. Ruled out: nonTransitiveRClass (msasikanth-twine sets it too and publishes), product flavors (this is a plain library), and any upstream exclusion of the group. It could not be reproduced locally — element-x resolves matrix-analytics-events from jitpack.io, which the sandbox blocks — so gradleProperties carries the hypothesis under test rather than an established fix: android.nonTransitiveRClass=false, which makes AGP generate dependency R classes into the consumer's R.jar. If a run with it still fails, the property should be removed, not kept. Tracked in compose-ai-tools#5026.
